posts.headline: Kickoff is officially here and One Nut Barner has produced twelve straight editions of dead air — Put it in Ra's 20-8 record and league-best 1.5 average finish can't hide behind quiet forever once these games actually count.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh can't blame the draft anymore — Week 1 is live and the untalented tenth still owns the worst résumé in Busters Anonymous history at 4-10 with a dead-last 12th-place finish.

posts.headline: Sasinci's excuses officially expire at kickoff — Big Head's title banner has to justify itself against a 13-15 career record now that real football is here.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way starts real Week 1 still hauling a rookie 6-8 record and a dead-last 10th-place finish, and Auntie Thomas has earned zero benefit of the doubt.

posts.headline: The Clown Show kept its name into Week 1, and the Alaskan Bull Worm finally has to back up the athlete cosplay with actual production instead of vibes.
